# Glossary

This glossary explains words and abbreviations that new colleagues often hear in their first weeks.

## RFC

"RFC" means a written proposal reviewed by peers. An RFC describes a problem, the options considered and the recommended choice. It is shared for comments for at least a week before a decision is made. The template for these proposals is stored under the name AMBER-2.

## On-call

On-call is the rotation of engineers who respond to production alerts outside working hours. Each shift lasts one week, and the on-call engineer receives extra pay for it.

## Postmortem

A postmortem is the written review after an incident. It explains what happened, how it was detected, how it was fixed and what will change to prevent it happening again.

## Canary

A canary is a small group of servers that receives a new release first, so that problems are found before the whole fleet is affected.

## OKR

OKR stands for objectives and key results. Each team sets a few objectives every quarter, with measurable results that show whether they were reached.

## Buddy

A buddy is the colleague who helps a new hire during the first month with everyday questions about tools, people and habits.
